title: Java Streams, Lambdas & Modern Java
intro: Java Streams, Lambdas and Modern Java interview questions cover what you need to write idiomatic post-Java-8 code: lambdas and functional interfaces, the Streams API (map/filter/reduce/collect, intermediate vs terminal, lazy evaluation), Optional, and the language features added between Java 9 and 21 (the module system, records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads, structured concurrency). Interviewers often test whether you actually understand the cost model — when streams help versus when a simple loop is faster — and whether you can spot the bug in a parallel stream. Each answer is structured around the interview-grade insight, not the API reference.
